ORDINANCE XLIV OF 1984
INCOME-TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Income-tax Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th September, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Income-tax Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of the First Schedule, Ordinance XXXI of 1979

ORDINANCE XLIV OF 1984
ORDINANCE XLIV OF 1984
INCOME-TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the Income-tax Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th September, 1984]
No. F. 17 (1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of the First Schedule, Ordinance XXXI of 1979.--In the
Income-tax Ordinance, 1979 (XXXI of 1979) in the First Schedule, in Part 1, in
paragraph DD,---
(a) in clause (a), for the
letters and figure "Rs. 1,000" the letters, figure and words
"Rs. 2,000 in any financial year" shall be substituted and shall be
deemed always to have been substituted ; and
(b) in clause (b),--
(i) for the
letters and figure "Rs. 1,000", occurring for the first time, the
letters, figure and words "Its. 2,000 in any financial year" shall be
substituted and shall be deemed always to have been substituted ; and
(ii) for the
letters and figure "Its. 1,000", occurring for the second time, the
letters and figure "Rs. 2,000" shall be substituted and shall be
deemed always to have been so substituted.
